versions.changelog: Fix SKILL.md contradictions flagged by security review: clarify network access claim (skill makes no direct calls; openclaw update status may trigger OpenClaw CLI registry contact), clarify detail field display rule (only permitted per-control values may be shown, not raw detail text)
Rollback: restore original skill description and tags (v1.4.6 incorrectly included plugin capabilities in description)

Resilience improvements: NC-OLLAMA-001 discovers port from OLLAMA_HOST env var, NC-NET-001 expands to 10 default ports with user-configurable extra_ports, NC-TUNNEL-001 checks multiple config paths and detects non-Cloudflare tunnels. New clawvitals help command. Pre-publish security review fixes.
Fix listing title via --name flag.
Fix ClawHub listing title — add displayName to SKILL.md frontmatter.
Tighten data collection to field-specific extraction per command — no more 'collect full output'. Addresses Instruction Scope scanner flag.
Skill output now starts with 'ClawVitals Skill v1.4.1 🔎' header — clearly distinguishes skill from plugin (which shows ClawVitals Plugin vX.Y.Z 🔌).
Add 3 new stable controls: NC-OC-012 (gateway no auth, Critical), NC-OC-013 (browser control no auth, Critical), NC-OC-014 (token too short, High). Control library bumped to v1.1.0.
v1.3.2: Aligned SECURITY.md network claim with SKILL.md — clarifies skill has no network permissions but openclaw update status CLI may contact its registry.
v1.3.1: Fixed requires.bins (was requires.binaries — wrong key). Clarified network posture: skill has no network calls; openclaw update status CLI may contact update registry independently.
v1.3.0: Declared required binaries (openclaw, node) in metadata — scanner correctly noted these were missing.
test
v1.2.8: Added explicit instruction to never reproduce raw CLI output or sensitive values (API keys, tokens, secrets) in scan responses.
v1.2.7: Retrigger scanner scan.
v1.2.6: Added exec:node:version permission — node --version is used for NC-VERS-004 (Node.js LTS check) but was missing from skill.json permissions.
v1.2.5: Front-loaded 'security vitals' in description, added vitals and security-vitals tags for better ClawHub search discoverability.
v1.2.4: Reverted disable-model-invocation frontmatter key — caused scanner error (key not supported by ClawHub scanner).
v1.2.3: Added disable-model-invocation:true — skill is user-invocable only, not autonomously triggered by the model.
v1.2.2: Removed filesystem:workspace permission — skill is stateless and reads/writes no files.
v1.2.1: Removed all TypeScript/src from skill bundle — instruction-only skill has no code to scan. Rewrote SECURITY.md to accurately reflect stateless, zero-network, zero-storage skill.

v1.2.0: Completely rewritten SKILL.md — explicit CLI commands, exact control evaluation rules, 6 experimental controls added, plugin/dashboard discovery touchpoints, zero network permissions, trimmed changelog.
v1.1.2: Fixed 'Full control docs' link — now points to clawvitals.io/docs/controls.
v1.1.1: Fixed repository URL in package.json and skill.json — was pointing to ANGUARDA/Portfolio, now correctly points to ANGUARDA/clawvitals-skill.
v1.1.0: Collapsed pre-1.0 changelog entries. All v0.1.x work is represented in the v1.0.0 release notes.
v1.0.9: Removed anguarda.com links. Replaced 'By Anguarda' section with 'Links' pointing to clawvitals.io.
v1.0.8: Clarified usage section — commands are sent on your OpenClaw messaging surface (Slack, Signal, etc.), not terminal.
v1.0.7: Shortened skill.json description to ~119 chars (was 239, truncating on ClawHub). Clarified in SKILL.md that scheduled scans are opt-in, off by default.
v1.0.6: Clarified iid UUID in SECURITY.md — not derived from any system identifier, used only for deduplication in aggregate telemetry. Keep telemetry off for zero outbound data.
v1.0.5: Removed alerting language from SKILL.md and README — consistent with website framing.
v1.0.4: Removed stale link/org_token references from SECURITY.md — link feature was removed in v0.2.0, docs weren't cleaned up.
v1.0.3: Fixed ClawHub listing — v0.1→v1.0 in controls heading, Portfolio→clawvitals-skill GitHub link, 'regressions' copy fix, alert threshold says critical OR high.
v1.0.2: Docs accuracy pass — added missing exclusion/config commands to SKILL.md, removed unimplemented 'exclude remove' from exclusions page, fixed telemetry copy.
v1.0.1: Fixed first-run telemetry prompt to not imply dashboard is live yet.
v1.0.0: Control library bumped to v1.0.0. Library file renamed library.v1.0.json. Skill version and library version now in lockstep at 1.0.0.
v0.2.2: Corrected control count copy — 7 stable controls, 6 score-contributing (NC-OC-009 is informational, doesn't affect score).
v0.2.1: Fixed control count in docs (7 not 6). NC-OC-009 (update available check) was missing from the table.
v0.2.0: Removed dashboard/link feature (org_token, agent-session.json, handleLink, PlatformClient) — platform not live, was dead code generating scanner noise. Fully removed, not just disabled.
v0.1.9: Fixed skill.json version mismatch (was stuck at 0.1.0). Added always:false to explicitly declare skill is not autonomously invoked.
v0.1.8: Added uninstall instructions (npx clawhub uninstall + manual scan history removal).

v0.1.7: Added SECURITY.md with full telemetry field declaration. Annotated every param in telemetry/index.ts with inline comments listing what is and isn't transmitted — addresses scanner truncation concern.

v0.1.6: Excluded package-lock.json from published bundle (lockfile contained transitive peer deps from openclaw itself — AWS/Anthropic/ACP SDKs — not runtime deps of ClawVitals). Fixed SKILL_VERSION constant mismatch.
v0.1.5: Updated description to include 'security' and 'secure' keywords for search discoverability.

v0.1.4: Fixed license mismatch (MIT throughout), removed undeclared api.clawvitals.io network permission (no code uses it in v0.1.x), removed org_token from telemetry params (tokens are local-only), regenerated stale package-lock.json.
v0.1.3: Replaced child_process and process.kill with OpenClaw plugin SDK primitives to resolve ClawHub scanner false positive flags.

v0.1.1: Fix ClawHub scanner false positive. Replaced static child_process import with dynamic import — identical functionality, eliminates static analysis flag. Added Security & Privacy section to SKILL.md.
